listed_sector_signals.signal: Paper's study sample is a pipeline construction firm that serves chemical and petrochemical industry customers; petrochemical is named as the largest consumer of the pipeline construction industry, but the paper's actual work is on pipe cutting/welding, not petrochemical production
listed_sector_signals.quote: the chemical and petrochemical industries as the largest consumer of the pipeline construction industry.

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50001 energy management system to reduce electricity consumption in the cutting and welding processes of a pipeline construction industry (a discrete construction/fabrication activity), which happens to serve chemical and petrochemical clients.
